name: Predator
description: Predator was a modified scout ship owned by Khlor, a Human bounty hunter active during the Imperial Era. The bounty hunter's hideout resided on a volcanic island on the planet Velusia. Khlor's prefabricated barracks featured a vehicle bay. Still, when the bounty hunter was hiding on his island, he landed Predator in a gully in the northern portion of his hideout, concealing it with camo netting.
